cards.target: Gülme komşuna, gelir başına.
cards.english: Don't laugh at your neighbor; it might happen to you.

cards.target: Sınav sonuçları gelince çok sevineceğim.
cards.english: I will be very happy when the exam results come.

cards.target: Düğün bayram değil, her gün yenilmez.
cards.english: A wedding is not a holiday; you can't have one every day.

cards.target: Yazın deniz kenarında tatil yapmayı çok seviyoruz.
cards.english: We love going on vacation by the sea in summer.

cards.target: Damlaya damlaya göl olur.
cards.english: Drop by drop, a lake forms.

cards.target: Misafir umulmadık zamanda gelir.
cards.english: A guest comes at an unexpected time.

cards.target: Sakla samanı gelir zamanı.
cards.english: Save the straw, its time will come.

cards.target: İzlediğimiz film ödül kazanmış.
cards.english: The movie we watched apparently won an award.

cards.target: Gördüğüm en güzel manzara burasıydı.
cards.english: This was the most beautiful view I've seen.

cards.target: Ramazanda iftar sofrası çok bereketli olur.
cards.english: The iftar table is very bountiful during Ramadan.

cards.target: Babam emekli olduktan sonra bahçeyle uğraşmaya başladı.
cards.english: My dad started gardening after he retired.

cards.target: Arkeolog kışın eski bir tekneyi boyadı.
cards.english: The archaeologist painted an old boat in winter.

cards.target: Bu yıl bahçeye domates ve biber ekeceğiz.
cards.english: This year we will plant tomatoes and peppers in the garden.

cards.target: Yeni taşındığımız sakin mahallede harika komşular var.
cards.english: The quiet residential area we recently moved to has wonderful neighbours.

cards.target: Öte yandan bu kararın olumsuz sonuçları da olabilir.
cards.english: On the other hand this decision may have negative consequences.

cards.target: Sen eve gelene kadar ben temizliği bitirmiş olurum.
cards.english: By the time you come home I'll have finished the cleaning.

cards.target: Gazeteci gün batımında deniz kıyısında deniz kabukları topladı.
cards.english: The journalist collected seashells on the coast at sunset.

cards.target: Ağır ol ki meyveyi çok olan ağaç gibi eğilsin.
cards.english: Be dignified so that you bend like a tree heavy with fruit.

cards.target: Beklediğimiz misafirler gelmedi.
cards.english: The guests we were expecting didn't come.

cards.target: Bayramda büyüklerin elini öperiz.
cards.english: We kiss the elders' hands during holidays.

cards.target: Bu rapor yarın sabah düzeltilecek.
cards.english: This report will be corrected tomorrow morning.

cards.target: Bu astronot yeni bir eve taşındı.
cards.english: This astronaut moved to a new house.

cards.target: Temel hizmetlerin hâlâ sağlanamaması kabul edilemez.
cards.english: It is unacceptable that basic services are still unavailable.

cards.target: Bir uzmana danışsaydın daha iyi olurdu.
cards.english: It would have been better if you had consulted a specialist.

cards.target: Yazar gece konser salonunda yeni bir hikaye yazdı.
cards.english: The writer wrote a new story at the concert hall at night.

cards.target: Hammaddeler fabrikada işlenerek ihracata hazır ürünlere dönüştürüldü.
cards.english: Raw materials were processed in the factory and turned into export-ready products.

cards.target: Bej pelerin takan rahip medresenin avlusunda ilahi okuyordu.
cards.english: The priest wearing a beige cloak was chanting hymns in the courtyard of the madrasa.
